exposure: Timing of prophylactic antibiotics administration (prior to surgical incision versus after cord clamping)
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean section (CS) in a single medical center in Israel between 2012 and 2015
finding: The timing of prophylactic antibiotic administration (prior to surgical incision versus after cord clamping) did not significantly affect SSI rates following CS.
mod_finding: The timing of prophylactic antibiotic administration (prior to surgical incision versus after cord clamping) did not significantly affect SSI rates following CS.
